content: Sinɑ boko u Esɑi bwisi bikiɑ
Sɑɑ ye sinɑ boko Esekiɑsi u ɡɑri yi nuɑ, yerɑ u win tiin yɑberu nɛnuɑ u ɡĩɑnɑ mɑ u sɑɑki suɑ u sebuɑ nuku sɑnkirɑnun sɔ̃. Mɑ u dɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ.
Yerɑ u Eliɑkimu win sɔm kowobun wiruɡii kɑ mɑɑ Sebinɑ win tire yoro, kɑ yɑ̃ku kowo bukurobu ɡɔrɑ Gusunɔn sɔmɔ Esɑi, Amɔtin biin mi. N deemɑ be kpuro sɑɑkibɑrɑ bɑ sebuɑ bɑ kɑ dɑ mi.

Ye bɑ turɑ mi, bɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, ɑmɛniwɑ Esekiɑsi u ɡeruɑ. U nɛɛ, ɡisɔn tɔ̃ɔ te, nuku sɑnkirɑnu sɔɔrɑ sɑ wɑ̃ɑ. Bɑ sun sɛɛyɑsiɑmɔ mɑ bɑ sun doke sekuru sɔɔ. Gisɔn wɑhɑlɑ ye, yɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe tɔn kurɔ wi u yiire u kĩ u mɑ, ɑdɑmɑ u ǹ dɑm mɔ u kɑ wɛ̃mɑ.
Sɔrɔkudo Gusunɔ wunɛn Yinni u ko n Asirin sinɑ bokon ɡɔron ɡɑri yi nuɑ wi u nɑ u nùn wɔnwɑ. Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, ɑ kɑnɑru koowo bɛsɛ be sɑ ɡinɑ tien sɔ̃ kpɑ Gusunɔ u nùn sɛɛyɑsiɑ.
Ye Esɑi u Esekiɑsin bwɑ̃ɑ ben ɡɑri yi nuɑ, yerɑ u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ,
wee, ye i ko bɛɛn yinni sɔ̃. I nɛɛ, ɑmɛniwɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u ɡeruɑ. U nɛɛ, u ku de ɡɑri yi u nuɑ mi, yi nùn bɛrum ko, yi Asirin sinɑ bokon ɡɔro be, bɑ kɑ wi, Yinni Gusunɔ wɔnwɑ mi.
U koo de Asirin sinɑ boko wi, u lɑbɑɑri ɡɑɑ nɔ kpɑ yu win bwɛ̃rɑ ɡɔsiɑ u wurɑ win temɔ. Miyɑ u koo de bu nùn ɡo kɑ tɑkobi.
Asiriɡibu
bɑ kpɑm Isirelibɑ nɑruɑ
Asirin sinɑ bokon ɡɔro wi, u ɡɔsirɑ u dɑ Libinɑɔ domi u nuɑ mɑ win yinni u doonɑ Lɑkisin di u dɑ u Libinɑɡibu tɑbu wɔri.
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ Asirin sinɑ boko wi, u nuɑ mɑ Tirɑkɑ, Etiopin sinɑ boko u nùn tɑbu wɔrim wee. Yerɑ u mɑɑ Esekiɑsi sɔmɔbu ɡɔriɑ u nɛɛ,
ɑmɛniwɑ i ko i Esekiɑsi Yudɑbɑn sinɑ boko sɔ̃. I nɛɛ, u ku de Gusunɔ, win Yinni, wi u nɑɑnɛ sɑ̃ɑ mi, u nùn nɔni wɔ̃ke u nɛɛ, nɛ, Asirin sinɑ boko, nɑ ǹ kpɛ̃ n Yerusɑlɛmu mwɑ.
Wi, Esekiɑsin tii u nuɑ mɑ bɛsɛn sinɑm be bɑ mɑn ɡbiiye kpuro bɑ rɑɑ tem mɛ mu tieɡibu kpuro kɑm koosiɑ. Yerɑ wi, u tɑmɑɑ u koo yɑri nɛn nɔmɑn di?
Nɛn bɑɑbɑbɑ bɑ Gosɑni kpeerɑsiɑ kɑ Hɑrɑni kɑ Resɛfu kɑ sere Edɛniɡibu be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ Telɑsɑɑɔ. Ben bũnu kpĩɑ nu bu wɔrɑ?
Nɡe mɑnɑ Hɑmɑtiɡibun sunɔ u wɑ̃ɑ, kɑ Aɑpɑdiɡibun sunɔ kɑ Sefɑɑfɑimuɡibun sunɔ kɑ Henɑɡii kɑ sere mɑɑ Ifɑɡii.
Esekiɑsi u kɑnɑru kuɑ
Ye Asirin sinɑ bokon sɔmɔ be, bɑ turɑ Esekiɑsin mi, yerɑ bɑ nùn tireru wɛ̃ tè sɔɔ ben yinnin ɡɑri wɑ̃ɑ, mɑ Esekiɑsi u tu ɡɑrɑ. Yen biru u dɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ mɑ u tu dɛriɑ mi.
U kɑnɑru kuɑ Yinni Gusunɔn mi, u nɛɛ,
Gusunɔ, bɛsɛ Isirelibɑn Yinni, wunɛ wi ɑ sɔ̃ wɔllun kɔ̃sobu yirun suunu sɔɔ, wunɛ turowɑ ɑ sɑ̃ɑ sinɑmbu kpuron Yinni. Wunɑ ɑ wɔllu kɑ tem tɑkɑ kuɑ, mɑ ɑ sɑ̃ɑ mɛn Yinni.
A nɔni seeyo ɑ mɛɛri, kpɑ ɑ swɑɑ dɑki ɑ nɛn ɡɑri nɔ, kpɑ ɑ Sɑnkeribu, Asirin sinɑ bokon ɡɑri nɔ yi win sɔm kowobun wiruɡii u kɑ nun wɔnwɑ.
Kɑ ɡem, Yinni, nɑ yɛ̃ mɑ Asirin sinɑmbu bɑ bwese dɑbinu kpeerɑsiɑ mɑ bɑ nin tem sɑnkɑ,
bɑ nin bwɑ̃ɑrokunu dɔ̃ɔ mɛniki. Domi nu ǹ Gusunɔ. Nu sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbun sɔmɑ ye bɑ kuɑ kɑ dɑ̃ɑ kɑ kpenu. Yen sɔ̃nɑ bɑ kpĩɑ bɑ nu kpeerɑsiɑ.
Tɛ̃, Yinni Gusunɔ, ɑ sun wɔro sɑɑ Sɑnkeribun nɔmɑn di kpɑ hɑnduniɑn sinɑmbu kpuro bu ɡiɑ mɑ wunɛ turowɑ ɑ sɑ̃ɑ Gusunɔ.
Esɑin ɡɑri
yi u sinɑ boko nɔɔsiɑ
Yerɑ Esɑi, Amɔtin bii, u Esekiɑsi sɔmɔ ɡɔriɑ u nɛɛ, bu nùn sɔ̃ mɑ Gusunɔ, Isirelibɑn Yinni u win kɑnɑru mwɑ te u kuɑ Sɑnkeribu, Asirin sinɑ bokon sɔ̃.
Ye Yinni Gusunɔ u ɡeruɑ Sɑnkeribun sɔ̃ wee. U nɛɛ,

content.text: Yerusɑlɛmun tɔmbu kpuro bɑ nùn ɡɛmɑ
bɑ nùn yɑɑkoru mɔ̀,
bɑ nùn wii ɡimɑnu koosimɔ.
Wɑrɑ u kɑm mɛɛrɑ u wɔnwɑ.
Wɑrɑ u kɑ nɔɔ ɡɔmunu mɔ̀.
U ǹ yɛ̃ mɑ wi, Gusunɔ, Isirelibɑn Yinni dɛɛron wuswɑɑɔrɑ u tii sue?
Win sɔmɔbɑ nɑ bɑ wi, Yinni Gusunɔ wɔnwɑ.
Mɑ Sɑnkeribu wi, u nɛɛ,
kɑ win tɑbu kɛkɛ dɑbirɑ u yɔɔwɑ
Libɑnin ɡuu ni nu ɡunum bon wɔllɔ,
mɑ u duɑ sere sere yen dɑ̃ɑ sɔ̃ɔ burɔn sɔɔwɔ
u ɡen sɛduru kɑ sipɛrɛn dɑ̃ɑ
ye yɑ ɡunum bo bɔɔrɑ.
U nɛɛ, u bwii ɡbɑ tem tukumɔ
u yin nim nɔrɑ.
Win tɑbu kowobu bɑ bɔsu Eɡibitin nim tori kpuro sɔɔ
bɑ yi tɑɑkɑ bɑ ɡo.
Adɑmɑ Sɑnkeribu u ǹ yɛ̃
mɑ wi, Yinni Gusunɔn tiiwɑ u yenibɑn himbɑ yi sɑɑ yellun di?
Wee tɛ̃ himbɑ ye, yɑ koorɑ,
mɑ wi, Asirin sinɑ boko u wuu si su dɑm mɔ bɑnsu koosiɑ.
Wi, Yinni Gusunɔ, u derɑ
wuu sin tɔmbɑ bɛrum soorɑ bɑ sekuru wɑ
bɑ kuɑ dɑm sɑriruɡibu nɡe yɑkɑsu ɡberɔ,
ǹ kun mɛ doo ɡɑ̃ɑru te ɡɛmi di.
Wiyɑ u mɑɑ nɛɛ,
u yɛ̃ sɑɑ ye Asirin sinɑ boko wi, u rɑ du dirɔ,
kɑ sɑɑ ye u rɑ sinɛ kɑ sɑɑ ye u rɑ yɑri tɔɔwɔ,
kɑ mɑɑ sɑɑ ye u kɑ nùn mɔru mɔ̀.
Yèn sɔ̃ wi, Yinni Gusunɔ u nuɑ
mɑ u kɑ nùn mɔru mɔ̀,
mɑ u tii sue win wuswɑɑɔ,
u koo win wɛ̃ru yɑbɑ u yɔni doke,
kpɑ u mɑɑ nùn yɑrukɑ dokeɑ nɔɔwɔ,
kpɑ u ɡɔsirɑ u wurɑ mìn di u nɑ.

content: Mɑ Esɑi u Esekiɑsi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, wee, ye yɑ ko n sɑ̃ɑ yĩreru wunɛn mi. Gisɔku kɑ ɡɑsɔkun doo ɡɑ̃riyɑ i ko i di. Adɑmɑ wɔ̃ɔ itɑse i ko duurewɑ kpɑ i ɡɛ̃. Mɛyɑ i ko mɑɑ resɛm duure kpɑ i yen mɑrum di.
Yudɑbɑn bweseru sɔɔ, be bɑ tiɑrɑ Siɔnin ɡuurɔ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ, bɑ fɑɑbɑ wɑ, bɑ koo kpɑrɑwɑ nɡe dɑ̃ɑ, kpɑ bu ɡbini ko sere tem sɔɔwɔ, kpɑ bu binu mɑ. Yeniwɑ Gusunɔ wɔllu kɑ tem Yinni u koo ko.
Yen sɔ̃nɑ u ɡeruɑ u nɛɛ, Asirin sinɑ boko wi kun duɔ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ. Mɛyɑ win tɑbu kowobu bɑ ǹ ye susiɔ bɑ n tɛrɛnu nɛni bu kɑ kuku yenu ko bu sere nɛɛ, bɑ koo sɛ̃u to.
Swɑɑ ye u kɑ nɑ, yerɑ u koo kɑ ɡɔsirɑ. U ǹ duɔ wuu ɡe sɔɔ. Yinni Gusunɔn tiiwɑ u ɡeruɑ mɛ.
Domi u koo wuu ɡe kɔ̃suwɑ u ɡu fɑɑbɑ ko win tiin sɔ̃ kɑ Dɑfidi win sɔm kowon sɔ̃.
Nɡe mɛ Yinni Gusunɔ
u kɑ Asiriɡibu ɡo
Ye n kuɑ wɔ̃kuru, yerɑ Yinni Gusunɔn ɡɔrɑdo u yɑrɑ u dɑ Asiriɡibun sɑnsɑniɔ mɑ u tɔnu nɔrɔbun subɑ wunɑɑ wɛnɛ kɑ nɔɔbu (185.000) ɡo. Ye bɑ seewɑ bururu, bɑ deemɑ wee, ɡonɑ nu tɛrie bɑɑmɑ kpuro.
Yerɑ Sɑnkeribu, Asirin sinɑ boko u ɡɔsirɑ u dɑ u wɑ̃ɑ Ninifuɔ.

Sɔ̃ɔ teeru u yiire win bũu wi bɑ mɔ̀ Nisɔrɔkun nuurɔ. Miyɑ win bibu yiru beni, Adɑmɛlɛki kɑ Sɑrɛsɛɛ bɑ nùn ɡo kɑ tɑkobi, mɑ bɑ kpikiru suɑ bɑ dɑ tem mɛ bɑ mɔ̀ Arɑrɑti ɡiɑ. Mɑ win bii Esɑɑ Hɑdoni u bɑndu kɔsire kuɑ.
